newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian oilseeds market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian oilseeds market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: The Bombay Oilseeds and Oils Exchange was closed for a Hindu festival.
The exchange will reopen on Tuesday.
On Friday, castorseed December delivery prices rose by eight rupees to 1,110/1,111 rupees per quintal on renewed buying and fresh export interest.
In edible oils, groundnut oil fell 12 rupees to 401/402 rupees per 10 kg on improved arrivals. Rajkot spot oil was steady at 550 rupees per 15 kg.
